title: S-B: conflicting evidence, three agents, two approvals
description: A lot leaves pre-cooling warm. The inspection certificate claims 1.0 C; the primary probe reads 4.2 C. Forensics attributes the excursion to the packhouse, the Strategist resolves a $250 near-tie by evidence trust, and an auditor from a different model family checks every sentence. Quality and Sales approve; the gateway re-routes to inspection and re-promises the tier-A line.
